config.tracker-key.name: Tracker Keybind
config.tracker-key.desc: The key used to open the fish tracker map from the collections page.
config.require-caught.name: Require Caught Fish
config.require-caught.desc: If enabled, you cannot track uncaught fish (silhouettes).
config.show-preview.name: Show Fish Preview
config.show-preview.desc: Show the fish image during the fishing minigame.
config.hide-time.name: Hide Time Info
config.hide-time.desc: Hide the fishing time requirement in the tracker info box.
config.preview-scale.name: Preview Image Scale
config.preview-scale.desc: Adjust the size of the fish image during the fishing minigame.
